checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp precompile execution time bounded and proportional to gas charged?

reachability.notes: Attacker searches for input combinations where actual execution time is disproportionately high relative to gas cost.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all input parameters to ModExp precompile (base, exponent, modulus lengths and values). 2. Benchmark execution time for various input combinations including edge cases: large exponents with small modulus, near-maximum length inputs, inputs with many leading zeros. 3. Calculate the ratio of actual_execution_time / gas_charged for each test case. 4. Identify any outlier inputs where this ratio is significantly higher than the average. 5. Verify that worst-case execution time does not exceed a reasonable constant k multiplied by gas_charged. 6. Test boundary conditions: maximum allowed input sizes, minimum modulus values, exponents with high Hamming weight.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0036, Trust Boundaries: tb-007, tb-008. Post-condition verification: Ensure no input combination causes disproportionate CPU usage relative to gas cost. PoC approach: Benchmark ModExp with various inputs and demonstrate outlier ratio of execution time to gas cost.

checklist.title: Verify EVM to ModExp Precompile Dispatch Validates Input Bounds

reachability.notes: Attacker searches for input combinations where actual execution time is disproportionately high relative to gas cost.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review the precompile dispatch logic at trust boundary tb-007 (EVM to precompile). 2. Verify that input length parameters are validated before memory allocation. 3. Check that gas calculation accurately reflects computational complexity for all input ranges. 4. Test with malformed inputs: incorrect length encoding, truncated data, oversized length fields. 5. Verify that the precompile fails gracefully without excessive computation when given invalid inputs.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0036, Trust Boundary: tb-007. Supporting check for boundary integrity between EVM and ModExp precompile.

checklist.title: Verify ModExp Gas Calculation Accurately Reflects Computational Cost

reachability.notes: Attacker searches for input combinations where actual execution time is disproportionately high relative to gas cost.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review the gas calculation formula for ModExp (EIP-2565 or applicable specification). 2. Verify the formula accounts for: base length, exponent length, modulus length, and exponent magnitude. 3. Test edge cases: exponent with high bit count but low numeric value, modulus that causes expensive Montgomery reduction, inputs that maximize iteration count. 4. Compare theoretical complexity O(max(base_len, mod_len)^2 * exponent_bit_length) against actual gas charged. 5. Identify any input patterns where the formula underestimates computational cost.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0036, Nodes: actor-evm, actor-modexp-precompile. Invariant check: gas_charged must be proportional to actual computational work performed.
